mission.title: Watchful Eyes
mission.description: Plant "security hardware" on a pair of computers at Zion command posts.

phase.briefing:
We require closer surveillance of our human allies. We wish for you to place listening devices in several of their bases. You will pick these devices up at our local base of operations and place them as instructed.
You will be picking up the tracking devices from Herschel. Go see him now.

enter.say: Herschel is a Redpill, just like you. It's good to see that others have considered the same options that you have.

objective.text: Pick up the tracking devices from Herschel
Pick up the tracking devices from Herschel

enter.say: This is the first location. Place one of the tracking devices on the specified computer. Avoid the patrolling guards, if possible.

objective.text: Plant the first tracking device on the computer

phase.briefing: You may now go to the final location.

enter.say: Place the last tracking device on the computer found at this location and make your escape.

objective.text: Plant the second tracking device on the computer
